record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, increase tied item embedding width and the corresponding hidden dimension from 48 to 64, propagating required shape changes without changing block structure or scoring. Greater representation capacity may capture more item relationships while retaining the parameter sharing that untied embeddings lost. Keep features, history policy, loss and optimizer fixed. Save the width in metadata and reconstruct matching predictor shapes; retain one model per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Increase tied item embedding width from 48 to 64 across all four category models. Existing hidden_units plumbing resizes the matching convolution channels, saves the width in metadata, and reconstructs matching predictor shapes. Preserve features, topology, scoring, loss, optimizer and one checkpoint per category.
